vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Diego. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You give A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find A man, maybe 50s. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — Jashim telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
🚶 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is back — found A man, maybe 50s.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (2 sticks now.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
👂 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 20s telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Farid. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek eats from the pantry.
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Better close to the fire today.
Stan sets out to find A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Willie, Jashim, Nikolai, Farid and Onni met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Jashim, Nikolai, Farid, Onni are hurt.
🛡️ Willie, Wilhelm, Jashim, Fabio and Victor met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 3 barely walked away. Willie, Jashim, Fabio, Victor are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
